objects.name: Miller Hobb
objects.greeting: Keep your voice down. They have ears like bats.|My mill. Forty years, and now there are Bortzal sleeping on my flour.
objects.topics: The Bortzal=A dozen came over the ford at dawn. The big one they call Grukk sits across the river, by their fire.; The mine=The Copperpit gate key came down with the last cart. I have it still.

objects.title: Take back the mill
objects.offer: Drive them off my mill, every last one, and the key to the old mine gate is yours. I have no use for it now.
objects.remind: They are still there. I can hear them.
objects.thanks: Quiet. Listen to that - just the wheel. Here is the key, and something for the road.
objects.reward: iron key x1, coins x80, grilled fish x3

objects.contents: coins x45, scroll of haste, bolt bundle x2, health potion x2
